selection_process: Merit List Basis:Selection for SCR Act Apprentice 2025-26 will be done purely on merit, by taking the average of percentage marks in 10th (minimum 50% aggregate) and ITI marks, giving equal weightage to both. || Tie-breaking:If two candidates have the same aggregate percentage, older candidate (higher age) will be preferred; if DOB is also same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier will be preferred. || Document Verification (DV):Shortlisted candidates will be called for DV where all original certificates (education, ITI, caste, EWS, PwBD, ExSM, RDAT registration, medical fitness) will be verified. || Medical Fitness:Candidates must produce medical fitness certificate from a government-authorised doctor (Gazetted, not below Asst. Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered. || Training & Stipend:Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training. || No Job Guarantee:SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there isno guarantee of regular railway jobafter completion of apprenticeship.

title: Staff Nurse
qualification: The candidate must possess General Nursing & Midwifery (GNM) or B.Sc (Nursing) qualification from a recognised institution as on the date of this notification. Candidates must also hold a valid registration certificate with A.P.N.M.C or any other council constituted under the relevant rules for the specific course. The marks obtained in GNM / B.Sc (Nursing) qualification will be taken for reckoning weightage for contract/outsource/honorarium service and for waiting period weightage after completion of the qualification. || If an applicant possesses an equivalent qualification, they must enclose a copy of the Government orders to that effect along with the application; failing which the application will be rejected.
age_limit: The upper age limit for the post of Staff Nurse is 42 years as on 01.03.2026. Age relaxations are as follows.
application_fee: Applicants must enclose a Demand Draft (DD) towards the application processing fee in favour of the Regional Director of Medical & Health Services of the concerned Zone (e.g., DD in favour of Regional Director Medical & Health Services, Guntur for Zone III applicants).
selection_process: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared out of a total of 100 marks. The merit criteria are as follows. || Academic Marks (75%):75% weightage will be allocated for the aggregate marks obtained in all years of the qualifying examination (GNM / B.Sc Nursing) or equivalent qualification. || Experience Weightage (up to 10 marks):1.0 mark per completed year after acquiring the requisite qualification as mentioned in the pass certificate. Weightage will be reckoned up to the date of notification as per Govt. Memo No. 4274/D1/2013, HM&FW (D1) Dept., Dt. 10.07.2014. || Contract / Outsourcing / Honorarium Service Weightage (up to 15%):Candidates working on contract/outsourcing/honorarium basis including COVID-19 service will be given up to 15% weightage subject to satisfactory service certified by the competent authority. COVID-19 weightage is 0.8 marks per completed month for service less than 6 months. || Weightage based on Working Area:2.5 marks per six months in Tribal Area; 2.0 marks per six months in Rural Area; 1.0 mark per six months in Urban Area. || CHOs (MLHPs) Weightage:As per G.O.RT.No.108, HM&FW(E1), service rendered in the cadre of CHOs (MLHPs) working in Village Health Clinics will also be considered for service weightage for future recruitment of Staff Nurse on contract basis. || The merit list of this notification is valid for one year from the date of publishing on the website. The Selection Committee reserves the right to terminate contract services at any time with one month's notice or as per Government directions.
